name: Pixel Trail
description: WebGL2 canvas that leaves a fading trail of lit pixel cells behind the cursor, with optional gooey blending, color ramp, image-colored cells, sparkle, gravity and click bursts.
contents: Relative container div filling its parent with a single WebGL canvas
Pixel grid trail following the pointer anywhere in the window
behavior: Trail follows the pointer across the window and is drawn only where it overlaps the container
Trail points age out over maxAge milliseconds with fade, shrink or dither decay
Cells get beveled shading with shine and an optional soft glow
Optional gooey metaball blending merges neighboring cells
Optional click burst spawns 14 points radiating from the click
Render loop pauses when the container is offscreen or the trail is empty
editableByProps: Grid density, trail size, lifetime and easing
Cell color, trail-to-head color ramp, or image-sampled colors
Cell gap, decay style, shine, glow and sparkle
Pointer flow, gravity and click burst
Gooey blending strength or off with gooeyFilter null
Container size and position through className and style

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the click burst particle count or speed

needsCodeEdit.where: SHAPES constant and the shape branches in the FRAGMENT shader

needsCodeEdit.change: Listen to pointer only inside the container
needsCodeEdit.where: window.addEventListener('pointermove', onMove) lines in the main useEffect
LIGHT constant in the FRAGMENT shader

fixed: Requires WebGL2, renders nothing if unavailable
Listens to pointer events on window, so the trail reacts to the pointer anywhere on the page
Container has pointer-events none and fills its parent, parent needs a defined size
Trail texture is fixed at 512px and the grid is square, based on the larger container side
Settings are read live but the WebGL setup runs once on mount
Image colors are sampled at gridSize resolution and need CORS-enabled image URLs
Pointer motion works on touch only as pointer events fire, no hover on mobile
Container class includes absolute z-1 while style forces position relative

options.look: Square pixel cells with beveled edges
options.useWhen: Retro or digital hero backgrounds where the cursor paints blocky pixels
Playful or soft landing pages wanting a dotted halftone cursor trail
Gem, luxury or geometric themed sections needing an angular sparkle trail
